verdict.rationale: An agent could query Metronome's billing state through its bearer-token REST API. The API has an OpenAPI spec, list endpoints with pagination, customer contract listing, multi-language SDKs and an llms.txt docs index, and data can also be exported to a warehouse for reporting. However, nothing shows an agent-native access path, and several of the named questions are not shown to be directly answerable. Missing for 10: an official MCP server or agent tooling, documented endpoints for MRR, delinquent/unpaid accounts and upcoming renewals, explicit invoice-listing-per-customer evidence, and hands-on corroboration of agents doing this.
